C0703.title: How Scalping Bots Exploited a Vulnerable API to Disrupt Online Retail Sales
C0703.summary: Imperva reported that a North American online retailer endured a scalping bot attack lasting about one month. The attackers exploited a vulnerability in the retailer's public API to bypass normal shopping flows, automate purchasing, and hoard high-demand items, increasing server costs and making it difficult for real customers to complete purchases.
